referenceFunction.generalComment: Production of a ventilation system for a residential care home with apartments, kitchen, cafe/restaurant, multi-purpose hall, laundry and car park. The inventory is based on a building with a total heated gross floor area of 11358 m2 and a total nominal air flow of 74580 m3/h, total weight of the components: 30520 kg/Unit, building with a specific air flow rate of 6.6 m3/h per m2 heated gross floor area. Data from call of bid including components for air handling units, ducts including insulation, air valves, roof-hoods, dampers, fire dampers, silencers. The data represent a ductwork mainly made of galvanized steel and includes air handling units mainly with heat recovery. System with central air handling units. Building without ground heat exchanger.; UUID: 22d75160-d40f-3e2b-b646-e614691124f2
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Materials used for the production. Energy use for the different production steps and for heating the production building. Transport of raw materials to the plant. Estimation for infrastructure of the production site included.
